title: SwReviewUserSettings
description: %APPDATA%\SwReview\settings.json. The API key is stored DPAPI-protected (CurrentUser) and never in the clear.

provider.description: fake is the scripted development provider: development builds only. A release build MUST refuse to load settings naming it and fall back to openai with a visible error (FR-027).

api_key_protected.description: DPAPI ciphertext; absent when no key is stored

python.description: Interpreter or uv path override; null = locate automatically

run_root.description: Where run folders are made: read when the add-in loads, and set in the Settings panel's field for runs, whose save restarts the backend with it. Blank or absent, the default, Documents\SwReview\runs. A local folder reached by its own path (owner decision 154A, with the owner's follow-up): every run start refuses a run root on a network share, reached through a link or written as a device path, before anything is made (RunRootRefused), and a save does not write such a folder chosen in Settings.

send_when_checked.description: Feature 015: whether pressing Review sends the review to the model when the code checks finish (true, and absent) or waits for Send to model (false). A review-flow setting, saved from the Review tab without restarting the backend.

standards_profile_path.description: Where the Standards profile YAML is on this workstation (feature 006, contracts/profile.md). The path only: the file is never committed and its schema is owned by the reasoning side. Absent in a settings file written before the Standards tab existed, which loads with the documented default.
